title: On 3-Connected Planar Graphs with Unique Orientable Circuit Double Covers
summary: A circuit double cover of a bridgeless graph is a collection of even subgraphs such that every edge is contained in exactly two subgraphs of the given collection. Such a circuit double cover describes an embedding of the corresponding graph onto a surface. In this paper, we investigate the well-known Orientable Strong Embedding Conjecture. This conjecture proposes that every bridgeless graph has a circuit double cover describing an embedding on an orientable surface.
